Hey y'all! Today, while just sitting here minding my own business a link was shared, by one who I know doesn't waste his time sharing without reason, so I click it, of course. I'm a writer, poet, actress, model, filmmaker, creative....artist. I like experimenting with different media formats and mixing it in unexpected ways. I've never known of a box to exist - not one to ever color inside the lines (I could even be misquoting that cliche metaphor). All I've known is what others refer to as "art" so for the lack of verbosity, I'm an artist.

TRUTH: My passion is film. All things film. I like working behind the scenes and love being in front of the camera. Anything that needs to be done to create a film, I'll step in and learn. I found my passion and it combines all my loves, and that's how I know. I'll settle for nothing less. Just creative passionate adventures.

A little strange, peculiar, an acquired taste, but at the end of the day, I love hearing other's stories, intellectual conversations, romantic walks on the beach not mandatory, I love my romantic summer evenings consisting of gaming or weekends making improv films. I'm a learning addict. I am captivated by the why's behind the who.

I like time alone, a social introvert. I love being in company of another but remaining in solitude. In my own world.

I could go on and on, but nah, that's for a different time. Thanks for the welcome, this space, and for reading.

Peaceful wishes
